repairs.rationale: Authentication traffic and stored identity data require the platform-wide encryption contract.
Buyer Workspace reads and lists are console-scoped and must enforce org_id plus console query scoping.
Pipeline advancement requires an authorized Workspace owner or member, enforced access, and the common failure-reason-recovery contract.
Vendor discovery and outreach advance Target Accounts through their canonical solicitation lifecycle.
Opening bidding requires versioned Requirement materialization, bridge redaction, and canonical Requirement and Response transitions.
Phase 10 scoring uses the canonical scoring engine and draft-to-locked lifecycle.
Selection begins only after Phase 12 entry locks the evaluation scores.
Phase 13 closure must perform the canonical Workspace and Bid Workspace state transitions.
Creating the immutable closure bundle requires canonical append-only mutation audit logging, binding retention, and nightly integrity verification.
The release gate requires accessibility proof, monitoring, recovery drills, observability, performance budgets, and the test pyramid before canary and rollback decisions.
The seven-stage onboarding contract requires release-blocking QA plus canonical event families, envelopes, durable delivery, and product analytics properties.
Domain Bootstrap creates KB Entries that must follow the canonical KB Entry lifecycle and indexing transitions.
